name: OCCULTIC;NINE
source:
Shikura Chiyomaru's fifth title that was first published as a light novel with Pako as character designer.

The story follows nine idiosyncratic individuals. Little incongruities that occur around these nine eventually lead to a larger, unimaginable event that may alter what is considered common sense in this world. 

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2015-03-28/steins-gate-creator-paranormal-science-novel-occultic-nine-gets-game/.86471]Anime News Network[/url]]
translation:
志倉千代丸的第五部作品，最初以輕小說形式發表，Pako負責角色設計。

故事圍繞九名性格各異的人展開。發生在他們身上的細微違和感，最終會引發一場規模更大、難以想像的事件，甚至可能改變這個世界所謂的常識。
